gates.name: identity_and_assay_harmonization
gates.purpose: Blocks name-only identity, unresolved isomers, unsafe pooling, cross-study batch correction, and irreversible imputation.

gates.name: discovery_and_core_model_contracts
gates.purpose: Validates stable core-model serialization, inclusion criteria, repository-aware recommendation rules, and mirage detection.

gates.name: provenance_and_multi_repository_safety
gates.purpose: Retains explicit source provenance, one-to-many repository records, conservative source routing, and checksum-bound unseen-cohort inputs.

gates.name: statistical_and_review_safety
gates.purpose: Keeps uncertain mappings or annotations review-gated and validates effect-search multiplicity semantics.

gates.name: dataset_readiness_and_motrpac_alignment
gates.purpose: Validates deterministic dataset-readiness scoring and evidence-aware MoTrPAC metadata-alignment gates.

gates.name: motrpac_style_plotting
gates.purpose: Validates MoTrPAC contrast/FDR semantics, release and coverage gates, hierarchy views, deterministic exports, and optional renderers.

gates.name: skill_and_agent_contracts
gates.purpose: Checks paired Codex/Claude skill contracts, implementation links, and agent review boundaries.

gates.name: benchmark_integrity_and_reproducibility
gates.purpose: Validates explicit benchmark denominators, independent-reference universe checks, CLI parity and isolation, provenance, and byte-reproducible pilot outputs.

gates.name: biomarker_directional_check_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates checksum-bound paper-direction evidence, repository-derived After-versus-Before analysis, measurement location, numerical safety, and explicit identity, timing, matrix, selection, and dataset-independence boundaries.

gates.name: predictive_model_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates cold-cohort split isolation, leakage controls, abstention behavior, metric denominators, and synthetic-only classifier labeling.

gates.name: domain_review_contract_safety
gates.purpose: Validates advisory-only domain review packets, complete evidence-state coverage, and non-executable review boundaries.

gates.name: scientific_readiness_gate_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates required-module collection, import-error attribution, and unique gate ownership.

gates.name: literature_evidence_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates that an unreachable literature index is recorded as unavailable rather than as zero hits, that truncated or relevance-ranked sweeps are never declared complete, that unscreenable records and unlocated subject names stay unresolved instead of excluded, and that preprint, peer-reviewed and retracted records keep separate evidence tiers.

gates.name: gene_centric_annotation_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates that a gene-to-metabolite annotation is never emitted as a measurement, that an unreachable source, a zero-row answer, an unannotated gene, an ambiguous server error, an indeterminate empty body and an unrequested context stay distinct states, that KEGG-derived rows are withheld until the licence question is settled, and that an unverified adduct or a rejected request is never written as a match or as a coverage gap.

gates.name: network_boundary_integrity
gates.purpose: Validates that only allowlisted live-ingestion modules import a network client, that offline pilot modules stay offline, and that the documented allowlist matches the enforced one.

limitations: Passing does not validate performance on independent real studies, assay platforms, species, or cohorts.
Database routing tests do not execute optional or planned external connectors.
Hierarchy plots are descriptive; dedicated pathway enrichment and cross-platform meta-analysis models remain separate work.
Skill contract scores measure structure and linkage, not empirical scientific validity.
validation_scope: offline deterministic repository regression tests over synthetic fixtures and checksum-bound cached public artifacts
